# C4C — Skill Profile

**C4C (Cards for Children)** is a children's global current-events card service. It delivers bite-sized, illustrated vocabulary cards for kids aged 5–8, built around real-world news topics curated and generated by an AI content pipeline.

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | Vanilla HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (ES6+) |
| Frontend Server | Nginx (Alpine Docker image) |
| Backend | FastAPI 0.115 (Python 3.10-slim) |
| Backend Server | Uvicorn (ASGI) |
| TTS | Microsoft Edge TTS via `edge-tts` library |
| Content AI | Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (`google-genai`) |
| Scheduler | APScheduler 3.x (AsyncIOScheduler) |
| Email | Gmail SMTP SSL (smtplib) |
| Containerization | Docker Compose v3.9 |
| Network | `myproject_default` external Docker network |

---

## Key Libraries

| Library | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `edge-tts` | Streaming TTS audio (ko-KR SunHiNeural / en-US AriaNeural) |
| `google-genai` | Gemini API — weekly topic generation from RSS news |
| `apscheduler` | 스케줄러 인스턴스 유지 (자동 콘텐츠 에이전트 비활성화, 수동 트리거만 허용) |
| `pytz` | Asia/Seoul timezone handling |
| `python-dotenv` | `.env` loading in local dev (Docker injects vars directly) |

---

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/tts` | Stream TTS audio for given `text` and `lang` |
| POST | `/api/log` | Append analytics event to `analytics.jsonl` |
| GET | `/api/visitor_count` | Increment and return visitor counter |
| POST | `/api/feedback` | Collect user feedback (batched daily email report) |
| POST | `/api/content-agent/trigger` | Manually trigger the content agent pipeline |
| GET | `/api/content-agent/pending-topics` | Retrieve last generated topic list |

---

## Content Agent Pipeline

1. **Trigger**: 자동 스케줄 비활성화됨. `/api/content-agent/trigger` 수동 호출로만 실행 가능
2. **Fetch**: Pulls real Google News RSS (`world+news+when:7d`) — no hallucination allowed
3. **Generate**: Gemini 2.5 Flash selects 3 diverse educational topics, outputs structured JSON
4. **Save**: Writes to `backend/pending_topics.json` for API access
5. **Email**: Sends HTML Stage 1 Approval email to `RECIPIENT_EMAIL` via Gmail SMTP SSL

```
C4C/
├── CLAUDE.md                  ← Environment & architecture context
├── SKILL.md                   ← This file
├── AGENT_LOG_DEPRECATED.md    ← Historical agent activity log
├── requirements.md            ← Latest content planning doc (current topic)
├── docker-compose.yml
├── Dockerfile.frontend        ← Nginx static file server (build context: .)
├── nginx.conf                 ← Frontend Nginx config (proxies /api/* to backend)

│   ├── index.html
│   ├── styles.css
│   └── script.js
├── assets/                    ← Card image assets (PNG, per-topic sets)
├── backend/
│   ├── Dockerfile
│   ├── main.py                ← FastAPI app + TTS/log/feedback/visitor endpoints
│   ├── scheduler.py           ← Content Agent (Gemini + RSS + email pipeline)
│   └── requirements.txt
├── scripts/
│   └── send_topics.py         ← Legacy standalone email script (kept for reference)
└── docs/
    └── style_reference.png    ← Visual tone & design reference
```

## Environment Variables (`.env`)

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| `SMTP_USER` | Gmail sender address |
| `SMTP_PASS` | Gmail App Password |
| `SMTP_SERVER` | SMTP host (default: `smtp.gmail.com`) |
| `SMTP_PORT` | SMTP port (default: `465`) |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | Google Gemini API key |
| `RECIPIENT_EMAIL` | Email recipient for Stage 1 approval requests |

---

## Key Conventions

- **TTS voice**: `ko-KR-SunHiNeural` at `-10%` rate for Korean; `en-US-AriaNeural` at `-5%` for English
- **Commit style**: Korean commit messages with `[에이전트 이름]` prefix (per project rule from `AGENT_LOG_DEPRECATED.md`)
- **Image assets**: Stored in `assets/<topic_name>_card_N.png` format; reference path in `script.js` data structure
- **Analytics**: Appended as JSONL to `analytics.jsonl` (persisted via Docker named volume `analytics_data`)
- **Frontend framework migration**: Previously noted as a future goal — migrate from Vanilla JS to Next.js + Tailwind CSS, with images moved to `/public/assets` (not yet implemented)
